The P^1 construction satisfies the Cantor child-fitting inequalities, yields a nonatomic probability on a polar compact set, makes every scaled multiplier ideal trivial, and has degree-one nonpluripolar product (1-s)omega and mass 1-s. The endpoint therefore has raw mass zero but canonical I-model 0 of mass one. All source applications and stated scope exclusions match the pinned primary sources.
